title: Acadia Pharmaceuticals Receives FDA Fast Track Designation for Remlifanserin in Alzheimer's Disease Psychosis
summary: Designation underscores the significant unmet need for new treatment options for Alzheimer’s disease psychosis, a serious condition with no FDA-approved therapies - RADIANT Phase 2 enrollment completed, with topline results now expected September to October 2026 and Phase 3 screening and enrollment underway Acadia Pharmaceuticals Inc. (Nasdaq: ACAD) today announced that the U.S. Food and Drug Administration (FDA) has granted Fast Track designation to remlifanserin, an investigational, highly selective, 5-HT2A receptor inverse agonist, for the treatment of hallucinations and delusions associated with Alzheimer’s disease psychosis (ADP).
